description: Check live bookability, pricing (US dollars), remaining spots, and refund policy for up to 20 sessions at once. booking_mode says where the parent registers: native (kiddinglab.com checkout, create_booking_handoff), platform_deeplink (the camp's own registration platform at registration_url, with the platform-reported availability.status, fetched_at and stale flag), listing_only (the camp's own website at registration_url).

sess_ids.description: 1-20 session ids (sess_id values from search_camps or get_camp_details).

name: get_sessions_and_availability
title: Check live availability & pricing for sessions
